response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS avg_all), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt, overall.avg_all FROM oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id CROSS JOIN overall WHERE oc.cnt > overall.avg_all), kavg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt AS order_count, k.cnt - k.avg_all AS diff_from_overall_avg, k.cnt - kavg.avg_kept AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kavg ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
